kv21.8:1.11: Hañci atthi aniyato rāsi, no vata re vattabbe
kv21.8:2.4: micchattaniyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsīti?
kv21.8:2.7: micchattaniyato rāsi, sammattaniyato rāsi, aniyato rāsi, no vata re vattabbe
kv21.8:4.5: Diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ upapajjavedanīyaṃ hoti, aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ hoti --pe--
kv21.8:4.6: upapajjavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti, aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ hoti,
kv21.8:4.7: aparāpariyavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti upapajjavedanīyaṃ hotīti?
kv21.8:4.9: Tena hi diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṭṭhena niyataṃ, upapajjavedanīyaṃ kammaṃ --pe--
kv21.8:5.1: Sāsanaṃ navakataṃ, Atthi koci Tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ navaṃ karoti, Labbhā Tathāgatassa sāsanaṃ puna navaṃ kātuṃ, Puthujjano tedhātukehi dhammehi avivitto, Atthi kiñci saññojanaṃ appahāya arahattappatti, Atthi adhippāya-iddhi Buddhānaṃ vā sāvakānaṃ vā, Atthi Buddhānaṃ Buddhehi hīnātirekatā, Sabbā disā Buddhā tiṭṭhanti, Sabbe dhammā niyatā, Sabbe kammā niyatā ti. 1.
